name: managed-notes
description: One entity nobody needs, plus the only thing this fixture exists for: an access block that names somebody. Every other descriptor in this directory declares none, which is the shipped default and admits nobody to the management surface — so a fact about a caller reaching a management route needs a project that granted one, exactly as a deployment does.

notes.description: A note. It exists because a descriptor declares at least one entity; no fact here reads it.
